newsitem.title: USA: Washington Water Q4 hurt by storm.
newsitem.headline: Washington Water Q4 hurt by storm.

text.p: Washington Water Power said its reduced fourth quarter earnings reflected ice storm-related expenses as well as reduced transactional gains from Pentzer Corp, its private investment firm.
Fourth quarter net income was $12.4 million, with earnings of $0.22 per share, compared with $30.4 million and earnings of $0.54 per share in the fourth quarter of 1995.

Year-end net income of $75.5 million and 1996 earnings of $1.35 per share, reflected the impact of $21.4 million in after-tax expenses related to last November's ice storm and its now terminated merger with Sierra Pacific Resources.
The company earned $1.41 per share in 1995, with net income for common stock of $78 million.
Merger and ice storm-related costs reduced 1996 earnings by $0.38 per share, with after-tax ice storm costs accounting for $11.1 million, or $0.20 per share.
